Constituent overlap

Unique Dana titles represented at each external institution in the Gold Rush export.

How to read this tab: “Duplicate” means a bibliographic holding relationship in this Gold Rush export. It is stronger than the earlier catalog-search candidates, but final retention decisions should still verify physical microfilm format and date/volume coverage. The three “Dana-only” titles mean that no corresponding external record was found in this particular Gold Rush export; they are not confirmed as exclusive worldwide. UCLA was absent from the supplied sheet, while the University of Chicago was included and is shown as reported by the workbook.
